title: UP Man Brutally Beaten For 'Trapping Hindu Girl In Fake Love': 'Shot Obscene Videos, Blackmailed'
text:
UP Man Brutally Beaten For ‘Trapping Hindu Girl In Fake Love’: ‘Shot Obscene Videos, Blackmailed’
During the two-year chat, he recorded an obscene video of the girl and then began blackmailing her for money.
In a recent shocking incident, a Muslim man, named Maqsood, from Uttar Pradesh’s Pratapgarh was brutally beaten up for allegedly blackmailing a Hindu girl after trapping her in false love. The man was chased out from a hotel to the streets by the girl’s family before attacking him with sticks. He is said to be critical. Later on, the Police officials admitted him to a medical college, from where he was referred to Prayagraj.
According to the victim’s statement, Maqsood befriended her through social media while hiding his real identity, and gradually it turned into a romantic relationship. During the two-year chat, he recorded an obscene video of the girl and then began blackmailing her for money.
Recommended Stories
Furthermore, it alleged that the victim has already provided Maqsood a total of Rs 2.5 lakh till now, with Rs 50 thousand transferred through online payment. Last Monday, he called the girl to a hotel and demanded another four lakh rupees. Also, he threatened to spread the obscene video if the money was not provided.
The girl’s relatives and several acquaintances arrived at the location and beat up Maqsood. The video of the incident is currently surfacing on social media. When the situation worsened, the officials launched an investigation into the hotel, and SDM Nainshi Singh seized the property as it was not registered.
After the beating, the attackers departed the scene. Upon receiving the information, the city police took the injured man to the hospital for medical assistance. Currently, the authorities are taking the issue seriously and a probe is underway.
In a similar incident, the UP Police recently arrested a man, Naveed alias Kasib Pathan, from Shahjahanpur on charges of raping a Hindu girl and attacking three others in a horrible criminal conspiracy. The arrest came after a young woman from Shahjahanpur reached the Chauk Kotwali police station and complained about Naveed’s criminal activities.
Just like Maqsood, Naveed befriended her on social media two years ago, posing as a Hindu named ‘Shiv Verma,’ according to the victim. He earned her trust by wearing a tilak on his forehead, a Hindu sacred thread (kalava) on his wrist, and even swearing an oath to Hindu deities to appear honest.
